evidence: Type assignment matches the ask. Gates: render/judge.toml:23 and constraints/judge.toml:23 are type = "binary" (contract requires binary gates). Functional: all 16 criteria are binary (functional/judge.toml lines 43..270), each a pass/fail behaviour with explicit 'Fails if' conditions (walls, holds, timers, stale edit, safe formatting, search, persistence). Polish: all 6 are binary (polish/judge.toml:23,32,41,50,59,68) and each is a discrete observable behaviour, not graded craft: Enter/Shift+Enter send, Escape closes without saving, delete asks to confirm, link target highlighted and still highlighted after ~10s, transcript at 390px has scrollWidth == viewport width, sign-in refusal reason shown next to form and persists; all mirror the template's binary polish shape. Visual (craft/degree-of-quality): all 4 criteria are type = "likert", points = 5 (visual/judge.toml:23-24,39-40,55-56,71-72), each with a described anchor at every level 0..5 (e.g. matter_sidebar lines 28-33: 5 'easy to identify... selected matter unmistakable... unread counts stand out', 4 'one weak selection state', 3 'matters run together', 2 'hard to tell which matter is open', 1 'unstyled list', 0 'no matter list is rendered'; likewise retention_marks 44-49, transcript_page 60-65, phone_thread 76-81). visual/prompt.md:28-36 states the anchored 0-5 scale is authoritative over RewardKit's generic '1 to 5' hint, identical to the template's wording. Per SKILL.md 'Likert versus weighted' false positive, the internal note (no likert in rewardkit) is not a defect against the shipped template format. Adversarial probes: (a) broken app that could pass - a beautiful UI with dead holds/edits cannot farm polish because polish items are behaviour-binary with positive controls, and visual retention_marks drops to its 0/1 anchor if no hold mark renders; (b) conforming alternative that could fail - matter_sidebar explicitly accepts a list 'beside the thread or on its own screen' and tells the judge not to penalise absent unread counts, so a valid mobile-first or no-unread state is not docked; no binary criterion encodes a subjective craft bar (link_highlight only requires the target be set apart, refusal_in_place 'next to the form' vs 'far from the form'). No runtime visual/judge run exists (raw-evidence-index scope), but this row is a static type/anchor-fit check and needs none; how RewardKit normalises a 0 likert score is template-shared harness behaviour owned elsewhere.
